title: Petra and the Verdict
author: Juniper Vane
blurb: Emrys Lockridge, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
